outline: This course takes new media art as its scope and creative coding as its main path, leading students to deeply explore the power and beauty which programming media can express. The course contents include new media art appreciation, creative programming language, common algorithms for creative programming, render and shader. By triggering coding idea from aesthetics, we can realize more fantastic interactive contents with powerful penetration.
